title: Standalone Sprint Review Evidence Checklist
description: Evidence requirements for reviewing a standalone QA Pilot sprint that does not span the full pipeline.

items.description: Sprint receipt must document all deliverables and acceptance gate results.
items.rationale: Sprint receipts are the primary artifact for reviewing sprint completeness.

items.description: Owner decision receipt must be present if sprint was sealed.
items.rationale: Owner decision receipts provide the authorization trail for sealed sprints.

items.description: No Librarian files were modified during the sprint.
items.rationale: QA Pilot sprints must not mutate Librarian state.
